reviews.text: A few years ago, my beloved Shetland Sheepdog (Moka) suddenly became ill after jumping off the bed one morning, so I went to the vet. They said there was fluid in her lungs, gave me some medicine, and told me to come back another day. I was like, "What? That's it?" She was breathing so poorly she seemed like she was about to die, and she was semi-conscious... She was having trouble walking and breathing. But they said she would be fine if she took the medicine, so I went home that day. I think they could have given her the medicine at least once at the hospital, but I gave it to her when I got home, and 30 minutes later, Moka was still in pain and nothing had changed. There was nothing I could do but wait and see... and then, three hours later, she passed away. The next day, the hospital called and asked, "How is Moka doing now?" When I told them she had passed away, they apologized, and flowers arrived the following day. If that's how they're going to handle it, I wish they had treated her more thoroughly at the hospital. I will never go there again. Thank you very much.

I used this clinic for the first time for my kitten's checkup!

Since it's by appointment only, there was no waiting time, and the kind female vet made it easy to discuss any concerns I had.

It's also close to Akebonobashi Station, and the prices are considerably cheaper than other clinics, so I plan to continue going there in the future. ☺️

They are very attentive and helpful when giving advice. Even after a long time since my last visit, they still know everything about my dog ​​(vaccinations, neutering surgery, and even his personality), which is something that might seem obvious, but I feel like it's rare to find a hospital that does that. I trust them very much.
I visited the hospital on a Saturday morning. The doctor's diagnosis was accurate. I would recommend this hospital.
